headline: Copper Enters Bear Market, Putting Downward Pressure on Chilean Peso
summary: Global copper prices plunged into a bear market, driven by doubts surrounding artificial intelligence capital spending, soft demand in China, and expectations of higher US interest rates. The slump weighed heavily on the Chilean peso.
why: Chile is the world's largest exporter of copper, making its national currency highly sensitive to international metal prices.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Copper entered a bear market due to weak Chinese demand and AI investment concerns.
